rule_transitions.source_rule: daily flight task drives flying hours
rule_transitions.reason: One mission block per operating aircraft per day; missions_per_day reserved as v1 aggregation.

rule_transitions.source_rule: failures occur only while flying; risk scales with flying hours
rule_transitions.reason: Failure sampled once per flight on flight entry with rate per flying hour.

rule_transitions.source_rule: scheduled maintenance is interval-based on the ground
rule_transitions.reason: Aircraft remains mission-capable while overdue; grounds only when scheduled work starts.

rule_transitions.source_rule: maintenance teams and hangar slots bound work
rule_transitions.reason: Scheduled work needs a team and a free hangar; corrective repair needs a team and a part.

rule_transitions.source_rule: part shortage causes AOG ground time
rule_transitions.reason: Corrective order blocked while stock is zero; aircraft grounded until part arrival.

rule_transitions.source_rule: reorder-point/order-quantity policy with fixed lead time
rule_transitions.reason: Order placed when stock plus in-transit is at or below the reorder point.
Dispatch pops corrective before scheduled; FIFO within each queue.

simultaneous_event_rule.reason: All same-time request triggers are visible before a free team is assigned.
